Name: Abigail eats rocks
Author: yugiboy9001
Description:
I always liked the memes of Abigail eating rocks with her indestructible teeth but i found it weird that no one to my knowledge has made a mod to change her gift dialogue to make it a reality. so i made this in a night to fix this problem. 
i'm not a good modder and this mod was just me taking an existing mod and using the coding skeleton as a base and adding my own stuff. it works for me but left me know if there are any bugs. also if you think my dialogue sucks please make a better version as i suck at writing. also there a few references to other games that might seem cringe or something but i was running on no sleep when i made this so i might change it after i sleep and think of something better.

what items does this touch? 
ruby, aquamarine, diamond, emerald, prismatic shard, stone, cinder shard, jade, frozen tear, quartz, fire quartz, topaz, refined quartz and earth crystal. 
i hadn't changed whether she loves or hates them so they are vanilla there. i didn't touch the geode minerals because i don't know how to edit gifting likes while packaging them into a mod.

install like any mod. its nothing special but if you have any mods that edit the same gift dialogue it wont work.

[b][size=4]Requirements[/size][/b]
[color=#d4d4d8]Spacecore, content patcher and their requirements.[/color]

[size=4]I reused the code from [/size][size=4]Unique Gift Dialogues Expanded by [/size][size=4] PrincessFelicie so go check her mod out as its really good and adds more gift dialogue to Abigail and more. [/size]
